SELECT sku_id AS skuId, (
COALESCE( (SELECT LEAST(SUM(quantity), 5) FROM tb_order WHERE open_id = #{query.userName} AND sku_id = o.sku_id AND status IN (1, 2)), 0 ) * 0.35 +
COALESCE( (SELECT LEAST(COUNT(*), 3) FROM tb_order WHERE open_id = #{query.userName} AND class_id = o.class_id AND sku_id != o.sku_id AND status IN (1, 2)), 0 ) * 0.25 +
COALESCE( (SELECT LEAST(COUNT(*), 3) FROM tb_order WHERE sku_id = o.sku_id AND status IN (1, 2) AND region_id = #{query.regionId} AND business_type = #{query.businessType} AND partner_id = #{query.partnerId} AND node_id = #{query.nodeId}), 0 ) * 0.20 +
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_channel c WHERE c.sku_id = o.sku_id AND c.inner_code = #{query.innerCode} AND c.current_capacity > 0 ) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
0.5
* 0.10 +
CASE WHEN o.is_discount = 1 THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END * 0.10 ) AS score FROM tb_sku o WHERE o.sku_id IN ( SELECT sku_id FROM (

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_channel c WHERE c.sku_id = s.sku_id AND c.inner_code = #{query.innerCode} AND c.current_capacity > 0 )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_order co WHERE co.sku_id = s.sku_id AND co.region_id = #{query.regionId} AND co.status IN (1, 2) )
) candidate_skus )
